const C='habit-v3';
self.addEventListener('install',e=>{e.waitUntil(caches.open(C).then(c=>c.addAll(['./','index.html'])).then(()=>self.skipWaiting()))});
self.addEventListener('activate',e=>{e.waitUntil(self.clients.claim())});
